props.name: length
props.description: The number of OTP input slots. Required so the root can clamp values, detect completion, and generate consistent validation markup before all slots hydrate.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: The input autocomplete attribute. Applied to the first slot and hidden validation input.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Whether to submit the owning form when the OTP becomes complete.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled OTP value when the component is initially rendered.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description: A string specifying the `form` element with which the hidden input is associated. This string's value must match the id of a `form` element in the same document.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the first input element. Subsequent inputs derive their ids from it (`{id}-2`, `{id}-3`, and so on).

props.name: inputMode
props.description: The virtual keyboard hint applied to the slot inputs and hidden validation input. Built-in validation modes provide sensible defaults, but you can override them when needed.

props.name: mask
props.description: Whether the slot inputs should mask entered characters. Pass `type` directly to individual `<OTPField.Input>` parts to use a custom input type.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: normalizeValue
props.description: Function that normalizes the OTP value after whitespace and `validationType` filtering. It runs whenever OTP Field normalizes a value, including initial/default values, controlled values, and user edits. The returned value is filtered by `validationType` again, then clamped to `length`. It should be idempotent because OTP Field may normalize the same value more than once while handling edits, storing state, and rendering controlled or uncontrolled values. Non-idempotent normalizers can compound across those normalization passes. Characters rejected while normalizing typed or pasted text are reported through `onValueInvalid`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the OTP value changes. The `eventDetails.reason` indicates what triggered the change: - `'input-change'` for typing or autofill - `'input-clear'` when a character is removed by text input - `'input-paste'` for paste interactions - `'keyboard'` for keyboard interactions that change the value

props.name: onValueComplete
props.description: Callback function that is fired when the OTP value becomes complete, or when a complete value is pasted while the OTP is already complete. When the value changes, it runs later than `onValueChange`, after the internal value update is applied. If a complete pasted value matches the current value, `onValueChange` does not fire. If `autoSubmit` is enabled, it runs immediately before the owning form is submitted.

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description: Callback fired when entered text contains characters that are rejected by validation or normalization before the OTP value updates. The `value` argument is the attempted user-entered string before normalization.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to change the field value.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must enter a value before submitting a form.

props.name: validationType
props.description: The type of input validation to apply to the OTP value.
